verdict.rationale: Sill is an open-source app that streams a Mac window or desktop to an iPhone or iPad. Remote-desktop products can plausibly ship developer SDKs, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no official SDK. Building the app from source with SwiftPM, or running SillHost on the command line, are developer building blocks rather than an SDK to build against, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
